title: Native reproduction must not be claimed
detail: Independent tensor reconstruction, paper/source gate discrepancy, span-key weighting, ARG query-leaf readout and project hyperparameters make this an architectural control. Docs/config already state this boundary.
recommendation: Use wording such as independently reconstructed GST-style span-weighted ARG architectural control.

title: Gate initialization is a disclosed interpretation
detail: Cached v1 Step5 groups W_g1, W_g2 and b_g2 in its zero-initialization sentence. The implementation zeros only the output layer and bias while the first gate layer uses ordinary initialization. Existing docs disclose this as an interpretation; it is not verified paper/native initialization parity.
recommendation: Keep that choice explicit in reproducibility material and avoid unqualified claims of exact paper-gate initialization.

title: Internal-node access and capacity differ
detail: GST reads all-node F47/topology with43300/166468 parameters; H020 uses leaf F47/Kron operators. Identical losses/support do not imply identical input aggregation or capacity.
recommendation: Report this access difference and both capacities when interpreting architectural comparisons.

title: Actual cache and execution not certified here
detail: Review uses source and handmade CPU data only. Frozen biological tensors, labels, model fits, GPU behavior, runtime memory and accuracy were not inspected.
recommendation: Retain separate root-owned actual cache/runtime/admission and experiment receipts.
